QuestInfo.name: Old Friends
QuestInfo.0: #b#p703##k in #m010006150# seems to be overcome with grief.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p703##k in #m010006150# wants her changed companions to rest in peace. She asked me to put to rest #r50 #o61#s#k nearby, as well as #r50 #o63#s#k deeper in the cave.
QuestInfo.2: Following #p703#'s plea, I had no choice but to fell the creatures that were once her companions. How did they end up like this...?

0.0: Human... You should not come here... This place is dangerous... What did you come for...?
0.1: Still... I have a request for you, human... They were my friends and my allies... but they have changed...
0.2: It pains me... I cannot leave them as they are... since they were so precious to me... Will you grant this request?

yes.0: #r#o61#s#k... and #r#o63#s#k, deeper in the cave... Please grant them a peaceful rest... I beg you...

1.0: I can feel my companions' souls... They have returned to the World Tree...
1.1: You have helped us... We will not forget you...

mob.0: #r#o61#s#k... and #r#o63#s#k, deeper in the cave... Please grant them a peaceful rest... I beg you...
